title: TicketSense app direction
question: The direction roll ran without catalog challengers. Choose the visual direction for the support-agent app.

options.label: Civic Wayfinding
options.lineage: Public transit and civic wayfinding systems
options.thesis: Every customer ticket gets a clear route to the team that can resolve it.
options.viewport: A compact app rail separates support tasks; the home workspace leads with classification and shows each result as a clear team and SLA route.
options.risk: The route motif must clarify a result without competing with the customer message.

options.label: Customer Care Desk
options.lineage: Contemporary service-desk labels and support-team workspaces
options.thesis: Keep customer messages and case outcomes legible at a glance.
options.viewport: A persistent app rail separates daily support tasks; the home screen pairs one real support-team image with the classifier and direct workflow shortcuts.
options.risk: The structure is familiar; the color system and routing treatment must give it a distinct identity.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean, conventional customer-support operations dashboard.
canonCard.viewport: A familiar sidebar app with a classifier workspace, routing results, and separate tools.
canonCard.risk: The familiar arrangement offers less product-specific character.
